limitations: Only even binary window lengths of at least six; auxiliary window weights restricted to two; weight-three windows each exactly once. Unique minimum window multiset, not unique Euler tour. No odd-length or unrestricted-superstring conclusion.
scientific_integrity: The all-even-order proof uses balanced overlap graphs, rotation necklaces, Mantel extremal rigidity and an explicit Eulerian construction. An included Python standard-library verifier independently checks minimum supports and Euler tours at even orders six to fourteen. Earlier equivalent unindexed literature remains a priority risk; no independent mathematical review has been performed.
title: Sharp parity augmentation of weight-three binary universal covers
